# FastRobox 1.0 — KiCad project

Editable schematic and PCB board outline for the wiring in [`../docs/FastRobox_Pin_Connections.md`](../docs/FastRobox_Pin_Connections.md).

**Status: UNVERIFIED.** The files are generated by `tools/generate_kicad.py` and checked by script (parentheses balanced, every net label sits on its pin, every net matches the pin table). They have **not** been opened in KiCad from this environment. Open them in KiCad 8 and run ERC before relying on them.

## Files

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `FastRobox.kicad_pro` | KiCad project file |
| `FastRobox.kicad_sch` | Schematic: one column symbol per module, nets as labels on pin ends, symbols embedded |
| `FastRobox.kicad_pcb` | Board outline only (100 × 70 mm). Footprints are added with **Update PCB from Schematic** |
| `fastrobox.kicad_sym` | Custom symbols library (ESP32S3_FR, RC522_FR, DHT11_FR, FLAME_FR, BUZZER_FR, TOUCH_FR) |
| `sym-lib-table` | Registers `fastrobox.kicad_sym` for this project |
| `tools/generate_kicad.py` | Generator. Edit the `NETS` list there, then re-run it |

## Symbols and footprints

- **Custom symbols:** all six are in `fastrobox.kicad_sym`. Each is one column of pins, named exactly as printed on the real part (for example `3.3V, RST, GND, IRQ, MISO, MOSI, SCK, SDA` for the RC522).
- **Footprints:** no custom footprints were drawn. Each module uses a standard 2.54 mm pin header of the right size (`PinHeader_1x08`, `1x03`, `1x02`, `1x01`), because every module plugs in with female-to-female jumpers. The ESP32 board uses `PinHeader_1x11` as a stand-in for its real header, so the PCB will need a proper board footprint later.

## Notes

- The **3V3** and **GND** nets each join several parts. In KiCad they are one net each, so the spliced-joint plan is shown logically only.
- The **RC522 IRQ** pin is marked no-connect.
- The **touch pad** is a single-pin header on GPIO1, standing for the bare jumper end.
- The **camera** is internal to the CAM board and is not drawn. Its pin map is still UNVERIFIED.
- **Flame sensor polarity** and the **buzzer rating** are unverified, so the schematic does not state them.

## Regenerate

```bash
python kicad/tools/generate_kicad.py
```
